description: This file contains utility functions related to minification, concatenation, and backup management of JavaScript files within the SuiteCRM project. It includes functions to exclude certain files from processing, concatenate multiple files, create backup folders, minify scripts, restore original scripts from backups, and handle recursive backup and compression of script files.

methods.name: get_exclude_files
methods.description: Returns a predefined array of file and folder paths to be excluded from minification and concatenation, optionally prepending a given prefix.

methods.name: ConcatenateFiles
methods.description: Concatenates groups of JavaScript source files into single files, respecting exclusions and minification rules.

methods.name: create_backup_folder
methods.description: Creates a nested backup directory structure based on a given path, ensuring each directory exists.

methods.name: CompressFiles
methods.description: Uses JSMin libraries to minify a specified JavaScript file while preserving license comments, and saves the output to a target path.

methods.name: reverseScripts
methods.description: Restores original JavaScript files from backup copies, optionally handling directories recursively.

methods.name: BackUpAndCompressScriptFiles
methods.description: Recursively backs up and minifies all JavaScript files within a specified directory, respecting exclusions, and optionally restoring from backups.
